verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Browserbase agents can be created from the dashboard by describing a goal in natural language and then deployed to run on a schedule or on demand. Supporting docs cover continuous monitoring agents that alert on breakage and webhooks that push status events so you don't need to poll. `pauseWhen` lets a run wait for human input and resume where it left off. missing for 10: detailed scheduling documentation (cron syntax, limits, retries) beyond a one-line claim, independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended background runs.
